SELECT c.*, s.name AS store_name FROM ecom_fba_claim c LEFT JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = c.store_id
c.store_id = #{storeId} AND c.claim_type = #{claimType} AND c.status = #{status} AND c.deadline <= #{deadlineBefore} AND c.status IN ('PENDING', 'SUBMITTED')
AND (c.claim_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.seller_sku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.fnsku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.source_ref LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.case_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.status IN ('PENDING', 'SUBMITTED') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, c.deadline, c.id DESC

SELECT claim_type, currency, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(est_amount), 0) AS amount FROM ecom_fba_claim WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'SUBMITTED') AND store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY claim_type, currency
SELECT source_key FROM ecom_fba_claim WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND source_key IN #{k}

SELECT r.id AS return_id, r.doc_no, r.store_id, r.platform_order_no, ri.seller_sku, r.currency, SUM(ri.qty) AS qty, SUM(ri.refund_amount) AS refund_amount, CAST(r.refund_time AS DATE) AS refund_date FROM ecom_return r JOIN ecom_order o ON o.id = r.order_id JOIN ecom_return_item ri ON ri.return_id = r.id WHERE r.store_id = #{storeId} AND o.fulfillment = 'PLATFORM' AND r.return_type = 'RETURN_REFUND' AND r.status = 'REFUNDED' AND r.refund_time IS NOT NULL AND r.refund_time <= #{refundBefore} AND r.refund_time > #{refundAfter} AND ri.seller_sku IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ecom_fba_ledger g WHERE g.store_id = r.store_id AND g.event_type = 'CustomerReturns' AND g.reference_id = r.platform_order_no) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ecom_fba_reimbursement b WHERE b.store_id = r.store_id AND b.amazon_order_id = r.platform_order_no) GROUP BY r.id, r.doc_no, r.store_id, r.platform_order_no, ri.seller_sku, r.currency, r.refund_time

SELECT l.store_id, l.seller_sku, l.fnsku, l.price, s.commission_rate, COALESCE(l.currency, s.currency) AS currency, l.material_id, l.pack_qty FROM ecom_listing l JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = l.store_id WHERE l.store_id = #{storeId}
mapper.sql: it.id AS inbound_item_id, ib.id AS inbound_id, ib.doc_no, ib.shipment_id, ib.store_id, s.name AS store_name, s.currency, ib.status, ib.ship_date, ib.receive_date, it.seller_sku, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, COALESCE(l.pack_qty, 1) AS pack_qty, it.qty / COALESCE(l.pack_qty, 1) AS shipped_qty, rc.received_qty, rc.source, CASE WHEN rc.id IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN it.qty / COALESCE(l.pack_qty, 1) - rc.received_qty > 0 THEN it.qty / COALESCE(l.pack_qty, 1) - rc.received_qty ELSE 0 END AS short_qty, l.price, s.commission_rate, (SELECT c.claim_no FROM ecom_fba_claim c WHERE c.store_id = ib.store_id AND c.source_key = CONCAT('INBOUND:', it.id)) AS claim_no

SELECT FROM ecom_inbound ib JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = ib.store_id JOIN ecom_inbound_item it ON it.inbound_id = ib.id LEFT JOIN ecom_listing l ON l.store_id = ib.store_id AND l.seller_sku = it.seller_sku LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = it.material_id LEFT JOIN ecom_fba_inbound_receipt rc ON rc.inbound_item_id = it.id WHERE ib.status IN ('SHIPPED', 'RECEIVED') AND s.platform = 'AMAZON' AND it.part_main = 1 AND ib.store_id = #{storeId} AND rc.id IS NOT NULL AND it.qty / COALESCE(l.pack_qty, 1) - rc.received_qty > 0
AND (ib.doc_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ib.shipment_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR it.seller_sku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY ib.id DESC, it.id

SELECT FROM ecom_inbound ib JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = ib.store_id JOIN ecom_inbound_item it ON it.inbound_id = ib.id LEFT JOIN ecom_listing l ON l.store_id = ib.store_id AND l.seller_sku = it.seller_sku LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = it.material_id JOIN ecom_fba_inbound_receipt rc ON rc.inbound_item_id = it.id WHERE ib.store_id = #{storeId} AND ib.status = 'RECEIVED' AND it.part_main = 1 AND it.qty / COALESCE(l.pack_qty, 1) - rc.received_qty > 0
